title: Log-Polynomial Optimization
summary: We study an optimization problem in which the objective is given as a sum of logarithmic-polynomial functions. This formulation is motivated by statistical estimation principles such as maximum likelihood estimation, and by loss functions including cross-entropy and Kullback-Leibler divergence. We propose a hierarchy of moment relaxations based on the truncated $K$-moment problems to solve log-polynomial optimization.
